function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

We need both status and trial_date for each case. We could call twice per case: once for status, once for trial_date. Or maybe we can pass details as array? But function signature says details?: "status" | "trial_date". So only one detail at a time. So we need two calls per case.

Thus total four calls: XY1234 status, XY1234 trial_date, GH5678 status, GH5678 trial_date.
